proposed_rules.trigger: An expanded FAQ answer ([region] node) appears as a sibling outside its accordion's parent container in the visual tree, instead of nested under its question, because the page-tree capture promotes absolutely/fixed-positioned open-accordion-panel elements out of their DOM parent.
proposed_rules.decision: When assembling the FAQ accordion block, re-attach any [region] node tagged as promoted-outside-parent to the question row it vertically aligns with (matched by Y-position/order), rather than treating it as a separate top-level section.
proposed_rules.rationale: This is an artifact of how our visual-tree capture promotes overlay-rendered elements (see page-tree skill's occlusion/promotion behavior), not a genuine site structure difference — the answer content still belongs to its question row.

provenance.evidence: C121 rc2c8c3 [region] and rc4 [region] both floating outside the rc2c8 accordion container

notes: page-15 healthcare-solution template: hero, feature grid, compliance/testimonial/pricing sections, CTA banner, FAQ accordion, footer. FAQ accordion has answer nodes rendered outside their row due to capture promotion of open panels.
